en.hero.eyebrow: Free and Open Source at uOttawa
en.hero.title: We turn students into architects of open-source systems.
en.hero.lead: The uOttawa FOSS Club is a student-led engineering collective dedicated to mastering FOSS, systems architecture, and security-first development. We bridge academic theory with industry-grade engineering by contributing to the global software ecosystem.
en.hero.stat.weekly.label: Weekly
en.hero.stat.annual.label: Annual
en.hero.stat.security.label: Security-First
en.mission.title: Mission
en.mission.body: We move students beyond being users of technology to becoming builders of it. From landing first PRs to analyzing real-world vulnerabilities, we learn by doing and ship work that lasts.
en.mission.callout.line2: If you can spot a typo in a README, you are ready to contribute.
en.pillars.title: The foundation of our culture.
en.pillars.card1.title: Active Contribution
en.pillars.card1.body: We provide a structured environment for students to contribute to major projects like Next.js. We help members navigate Good First Issues and land their first merged PRs.
en.pillars.card2.title: Systems-Level Mastery
en.pillars.card2.body: Our flagship annual event, Linux From Scratch Week, involves building an entire operating system from source. Students demystify the kernel, toolchains, and hardware-software interfaces.
en.pillars.card3.title: Security-First Engineering
en.pillars.card3.body: We analyze real-world vulnerabilities and bug bounty reports to understand how software is exploited. Members learn to build hardened, resilient software.
en.activities.title: Hands-on experiences all year long.
en.activities.card1.title: First PR Workshops
en.activities.card1.body: Learn how to make your first PR, navigate maintainer feedback, and practice the etiquette of working in global FOSS communities.
en.activities.card2.title: Secure Software Workshops
en.activities.card2.body: Hands-on sessions on building software that is hard to exploit, with practical lessons on sandboxing and secure defaults.
en.activities.card3.title: Linux From Scratch
en.activities.card3.body: An annual deep-dive week where we build a Linux system from source and learn how every layer of the stack fits together.
en.activities.card4.title: Weekly Co-Hacking
en.activities.card4.body: A consistent shared space to collaborate, review code, and push contributions forward together.
en.activities.card5.title: Security Review Circles
en.activities.card5.body: We review weekly CVEs, dig into post-mortems, and discuss ethical disclosure in our active Discord.
en.activities.card6.title: Merged Gala
en.activities.card6.body: End-of-semester celebration recognizing students whose open-source contributions have been merged.
en.tracks.title: Pick a depth area and go further.
en.tracks.card1.title: Web Architecture
en.tracks.card1.body: Learn how global products are designed, deployed, and scaled. Study modern frameworks and contribute to widely used web tooling.
en.tracks.card2.title: Low-Level Systems Engineering
en.tracks.card2.body: Dive into kernels, compilers, and hardware interfaces. Build a sharper understanding of how computers actually work.
en.tracks.card3.title: Security Auditing
en.tracks.card3.body: Explore real exploit chains, bug bounty reports, and supply chain attacks. Learn to engineer defenses from day one.
en.join.title: Build software that lasts and secure the open web.
en.join.body: Whether you are a first-year student or a seasoned developer, you will find a community ready to help you contribute.
en.footer.title: uOttawa FOSS Club
